ALAS2023-2026-3365

Amazon Linux 2023 Security Advisory: ALAS2023-2026-3365
Advisory Released Date: 2026-10-30
Advisory Updated Date: 2026-11-02
Severity: Important
References: CVE-2026-98432 
FAQs regarding Amazon Linux ALAS/CVE Severity
Issue Overview:

In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

ipv4: free inet_opt and ireq_opt after an RCU grace period (CVE-2026-98432)


Affected Packages:

kernel


Issue Correction:
Run dnf update kernel --releasever 2023.12.20261102 or dnf update --advisory ALAS2023-2026-3365 --releasever 2023.12.20261102 to update your system.
More information on how to update your system can be found on this page: Amazon Linux 2023 documentation
